notes: The A2A listener is off unless a2a.json, PIG_A2A_LISTEN or --a2a-listen configures it, and it refuses to start without authentication tokens.
The extension is Go and fuses into the Piglet Binary; it depends on the upstream a2a-go v2.6.0 (Apache-2.0).
Also selected by pig-with-batteries; the listener is off there too until configured.

Signed Binaries for the five manifest targets are published as GitHub Release a2a/v0.1.1 (built natively by the release workflow; pull one with pig piglet pull github:MichaelKinsy/pigpen/a2a@0.1.1); the local runs in this repository are linux/amd64 only, and no platform is a support claim.
